summary_zh: ThinkRail 是围绕 pi 编码智能体构建的智能体 IDE，用独立 git worktree 工作区隔离任务，让多个智能体并行工作而互不干扰；它以 SPEC.md 规格图和可复用技能为智能体提供持久项目知识，并提供可拆分编辑器、终端、多会话聊天、PR 与 CI 管理等完整开发界面，支持自带模型提供商。
audience_zh: 适合习惯使用编码智能体、希望在真实 IDE 中并行处理多个分支任务并管理 GitHub PR 的开发者；也适合重视项目规格文档、偏好自带模型凭据与自定义模型服务的团队和个人用户。

evidence.quote: Vibe code with pi in a lightweight, real IDE that customises itself around the way you work — The Vibe You Need
ThinkRail is the agentic IDE that gets better every time you use it — learning your project through
- **Isolated workspaces.** Open any git repo as a project and cut workspaces from it as `git worktree`s,
- **A real IDE around the agent.** A splittable workbench of Monaco editor tabs, a Files tree with live git
